Complete game architecture for large-scale agent societies in a persistent top-down 3D physical world. Hundreds to thousands of agents run purely deterministic rule-based logic with accumulated personality/relationship history and hard knowledge limits. Agent-to-agent communication uses machine data only and is hard-throttled to human-scale bandwidth per second. Full physics simulation is decoupled from rendering. A single LLM acts solely as bidirectional translator between player and agents. Saved compute is redirected into more agents, minor NPCs and lightweight monsters. Public domain.
